system.description:
AURA SHAMAN SPIRIT UTILITY
Shaman Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Area 20-foot emanation
Duration Sustained, up to 1 minute

The boundary between the physical and spiritual world becomes temporarily transparent around you.
You and willing allies within the area can perceive disembodied spirits, incorporeal Undead, manifested haunts and possessing entities where the possession effect allows the entity to be separately targeted. Those creatures are perceived clearly enough to be targeted.
Furthermore, spells and magical attacks made by affected creatures treat incorporeal spirits as though the attacker possessed the normal means required to affect them.
This does not remove the Incorporeal trait, allow mundane weapons to affect creatures they could not normally harm, reveal an entity's identity or allegiance, expose a possession whose rules explicitly prevent the possessor from being targeted, or bypass an Immunity unrelated to incorporeality.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the emanation by 10 feet.
+4 PP: The spell no longer requires Sustaining and lasts for 1 minute.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
